title: Ada bar Ukhmi
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Mentioned in Beitzah 26b, where he recited mishnayot and garbled them. As for the reading R’ Abba bar Ikhoma in Taanit 1:3, Hyman says that the patronymic there should read bar Avimi.[^1]

notes.text: The William Davidson Beitzah 26b paragraph names Ada bar Ukhme. The Guggenheimer Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 1:3 paragraph instead fully writes Rav Ada bar Ikhuma, beside Hyman’s R’ Abba bar Ikhoma. Hyman’s proposed bar Avimi is not adopted as a correction to that digital text or an identity record.
